title: main returning -1 fails
purpose: Out-of-range or non-int entry results must fail, never wrap or default.

failure.justification: Spec 3 requires the out-of-range result to fail without fixing the stage; a constant result may be diagnosed statically, otherwise the entry boundary check fails at runtime. Either way no status is produced.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
